data.one_liner: Generates Dart constants for your asset paths with image preview support.
data.what_it_does: Scans your project assets and generates an r.dart file containing type-safe constants for asset paths. It also includes comments to allow image previewing by hovering over the constants in supported IDEs.
use_when: You want to avoid typos when referencing asset paths in your code
You want IDE hover previews for your image assets
avoid_when: You prefer manual string paths or do not use build_runner
You do not use asset files in your project
strengths: Reduces spelling errors for asset paths
Supports image previewing via IDE hover
weaknesses: Requires running build_runner to update constants
Limited to what can be statically generated from pubspec assets
data.setup_notes: Add to dev_dependencies and run flutter packages pub run build_runner build.
